drk.text: Baron Sengir's story begins when his father tries to become immortal through black magic and vampirism, bringing his son along, and young Sengir and the orphan Ravi lead plague rats against the baron.
The rats kill both the boy and the baron, and Sengir revives as a vampire, and centuries later he frees the mad crone Ravi from a sealed coffin in the Dead Zone and names her Grandmother Sengir.
Stranded on Ulgrotha after being summoned during a planeswalker duel, he slaughters the dwarves of the Castle of Morning Light, kidnaps the king's daughter and renames her Irini Sengir.
He sends vampires against Aysen, warns Serra and Feroz not to interfere, and after Feroz's death reprimands Serra until she leaves Ulgrotha.

hml.text: Baron Sengir is stranded after two planeswalkers duel, slays or undeads the dwarves, takes their castle and turns Irini into a vampire.
When Feroz and Serra arrive, he moves against them, and after Feroz dies in a laboratory accident he manipulates the grieving Serra into leaving the plane, so the Ban begins to fail.

With Serra gone, he plots to take control while the civilizations fight, offering the Death Speakers black magic books to win control of them and twisting a corrupt wizard savant into the first greater werewolf.
